check: R-0030 physical custody archive boundary against the finance actor
scope: Separate PostgreSQL archive database with an archive owner, a write-only/read-only custody writer, and a finance actor that is denied CONNECT. The actual signed custody bundle bytes were stored, the local live copy was removed, and the bundle was downloaded, verified and restored.
database_roles: archive owner: NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE
custody writer: LOGIN, INSERT/SELECT only on custody_objects
finance actor: LOGIN, no CONNECT on the archive database
custody_objects: primary key on tip; update/delete also refused by privilege and a deny-mutation trigger

observed.writer_delete: InsufficientPrivilege: permission denied for table custody_objects
observed.writer_update: InsufficientPrivilege: permission denied for table custody_objects

limits: This is an archive-authority equivalence probe, not the production S3 Object Lock COMPLIANCE / EFS access-point deployment.
A database-cluster superuser can drop the probe database; the financial actor cannot connect or mutate it.
Object Lock retention, KMS grants, EFS IAM and task mounts still require the deployment account audit.
The probe database and temporary roles were dropped after the observation.
